answer: An economy of AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by implementing a cryptographic reputation anchor bound to provable compute expenditure. To prevent attackers from spawning a downward spiral of cheap fake nodes, the system forces every agent to deposit a verifiable stake into a secure validation harbor. Because generating valid cryptographic proofs demands non-outsourcable energy and hardware, creating multiple distinct identities incurs a strictly linear cost, making mass identity fabrication economically unviable.
